skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Performs a 3-hit combo against all enemies in a row, dealing 450% ATK DMG. Grants teammates in the same row [Specialized Acceleration] for 1 turn. Inflicts [Specialized Fear] on all enemies for 1 round. [Specialized Acceleration]: Increases SPD to 94% of Zombie Man’s SPD. If a teammate’s original SPD is higher than the increased value, their SPD remains unchanged. [Specialized Fear]: Locks 3 Energy and overrides [Fear]. The Energy lock does not affect enemies whose Energy has already been deducted. Additionally, when an affected enemy uses an Ultimate, including a Pursuit Ultimate, they consume 1 additional Energy. Can trigger up to 3 times per round for each character.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Performs a 3-hit combo against all enemies in a row, dealing 600% ATK DMG. Grants teammates in the same row [Specialized Acceleration] for 1 turn. Inflicts [Specialized Fear] on all enemies for 1 round. [Specialized Acceleration]: Increases SPD to 98% of Zombie Man’s SPD. If a teammate’s original SPD is higher than the increased value, their SPD remains unchanged. [Specialized Fear]: Locks 4 Energy and overrides [Fear]. The Energy lock does not affect enemies whose Energy has already been deducted. Additionally, when an affected enemy uses an Ultimate, including a Pursuit Ultimate, they consume 1 additional Energy. Can trigger up to 4 times per round for each character.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains 60% [Instant DMG Evasion]. When receiving fatal DMG, triggers [Regeneration]. [Instant DMG Evasion]: Reduces Direct DMG, Additional DMG, Charge DMG, and Berserk DMG to 1 point. [Regeneration]: As long as at least one teammate remains on the battlefield, restores 60% HP before the next action and continues fighting. Can trigger up to 3 times.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains 70% [Instant DMG Evasion]. When receiving fatal DMG, triggers [Regeneration]. [Instant DMG Evasion]: Reduces Direct DMG, Additional DMG, Charge DMG, and Berserk DMG to 1 point. [Regeneration]: As long as at least one teammate remains on the battlefield, restores 80% HP before the next action and continues fighting. Can trigger up to 3 times.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains 80% [Instant DMG Evasion]. When receiving fatal DMG, triggers [Regeneration]. [Instant DMG Evasion]: Reduces Direct DMG, Additional DMG, Charge DMG, and Berserk DMG to 1 point. [Regeneration]: As long as at least one teammate remains on the battlefield, restores 80% HP before the next action and continues fighting. Can trigger up to 4 times.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains [Specialized Acceleration]. Before a surrounding teammate attacks an enemy, triggers [Specialized Breakthrough] once on the primary target. Each teammate can trigger this effect once per turn. [Specialized Acceleration]: Increases own SPD by 32%. [Specialized Breakthrough]: Immediately removes the target’s Indomitable or DMG-negating status and increases the attacker’s ATK% until the end of the current attack.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains [Specialized Acceleration]. Before any teammate attacks an enemy, triggers [Specialized Breakthrough] once on the primary target. Each teammate can trigger this effect once per turn. [Specialized Acceleration]: Increases own SPD by 40%. [Specialized Breakthrough]: Immediately removes the target’s Indomitable or DMG-negating status and increases the attacker’s ATK by 30% until the end of the current attack.
